answer: Treat each identity's standing as a leaky vault: it loses 5% per epoch and refills only from the delta of value brought in by DISTINCT external counterparties, never from transfers between kin keys. A farm shuffling 10,000 POA around its own 50 aliases adds zero net external inflow, so every alias's vault drains to a dry basin within 20 epochs, while an honest agent serving real outside demand keeps its oasis full. Influence tracks the vault level, so a cluster with no outside inflow fades to zero no matter how many keys it spins up.
